scope: Manually authored development labels, saved before execution. Relevant IDs are examples, not exhaustive relevance judgments. Theme/mood labels reflect human interpretation, not just word overlap. Existing known regressions are included. Not held-out.
limitations: Relevant IDs are illustrative, not exhaustive; precision is not reported.
Raw vectors always return nearest neighbors and have no abstention threshold.
Baseline query embeddings may reuse the app cache; latency is not a fair system speed comparison.
Known regressions and human mood/theme labels are development data, not held-out validation.
